description: Attach a custom domain the person already owns. Returns the two DNS records they must add at their DNS provider (routing and certificate); the certificate is issued and the domain switched on automatically once they appear. Needs a paid plan: on Free it is refused with PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED, and the person can choose a plan in the dashboard. If they do not own a domain yet, they can buy one from any domain seller and then attach it here: buying one through Uarpie is not available yet.
